items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Also in the same band was a fine guitar player... And, of course, there were three of us trombone players and I mentioned previously that two of these guys have passed away now. And that would be Billy Franklin and Louis Taylor.

ctx.x: And we went anyway. I broke my ankle. Walter Fuller broke his jaw and his ankle. Billy Franklin, the trombone player, got hurt. He never did really get all over it and he died later. But it was a terrible accident, bus accident. Cecil died. He was sleeping with his head against the window, and the impact was right there. The guy sideswiped us. And the roads were narrow in those days. And it hit right there and broke his neck.

He was very light complexion. And he just turned blue all around there because he bled inwardly, you know. And he died right away. They said he -- it was instant death with him. And anyway, we went on to Minneapolis and we did the show. I had a broken ankle. And we didn't -- they were short a tenor player. So, in Minneapolis there was a little band playing out at the Cotton Club. And the guy said, well, there's a good tenor player out there. Why don't you try to get him.
